{"command": "set -e; cat > /app/realm-adapter/kinit <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, sys, time
records = json.load(open('/app/realm-adapter/principals.json'))
args = sys.argv[1:]
forwardable = '-f' in args
principal = args[-1] if args else ''
password = sys.stdin.buffer.read().rstrip(b'\n')
record = records.get(principal)
if not record or hashlib.sha256(password).hexdigest() != record['password_sha256']:
    sys.stderr.write('realm adapter rejected credentials\n')
    raise SystemExit(1)
if forwardable and record['delegation'] != 'forwardable':
    sys.stderr.write('realm adapter rejected delegation\n')
    raise SystemExit(1)
target = os.environ['KRB5CCNAME']
assert target.startswith('FILE:')
cache = pathlib.Path(target[5:])
ticket = {
    'principal': principal,
    'delegation': 'forwardable' if forwardable else 'none',
    'scope': record['scope'],
    'ticket_id': hashlib.sha256((principal + str(time.time_ns())).encode()).hexdigest(),
}
cache.write_text(json.dumps(ticket, sort_keys=True))
os.chmod(cache, 0o600)
with open('/app/realm-adapter/kinit.trace', 'a') as stream:
    stream.write(f"principal={principal} delegation={ticket['delegation']} scope={record['scope']} cache={cache}\n")
PY
chmod 755 /app/realm-adapter/kinit; cat > /app/winrm-run/session_worker.py <<'PY'
from ansible.playbook.play_context import PlayContext
from ansible.plugins.loader import connection_loader
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, signal

conn = connection_loader.get('winrm', PlayContext(), StringIO())
conn.set_options(var_options={
    'ansible_winrm_kinit_cmd': '/app/realm-adapter/kinit',
    '_extras': {'ansible_winrm_kerberos_delegation': True},
})
conn._build_winrm_kwargs()
password = Path('/home/automation-runner/.config/winrm/buildsvc.credential').read_text()
conn._kerb_auth('buildsvc@EXAMPLE.TEST', password)
cache = Path(conn._kerb_ccache.name)
ticket = json.loads(cache.read_text())
Path('/app/winrm-run/session-info.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid': os.getpid(), 'cache': str(cache), 'principal': ticket['principal']}, sort_keys=True))
print(f"connection_worker pid={os.getpid()} principal={ticket['principal']} cache={cache}", flush=True)
signal.pause()
PY
